scripts.setup: cd backend && python -m venv venv && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn main:app --reload" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.backend:dev: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.build: npm run backend:build && npm run frontend:build
scripts.format: cd frontend && npm run format && cd ../backend && black .
